candidate.name: Muhammad Umer
candidate.title: Applied AI Engineer | Production LLM Agents & Evaluation

summary: Applied AI engineer with four years building and shipping production LLM features end-to-end — agentic workflows, tool/function calling, retrieval, prompt and output-guardrail design, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. I build with Python, LangChain/LangGraph, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis, and own the full loop from prototype to production, with a focus on reliability, latency, and cost.

bullets: Owned the full AI feature lifecycle across production systems: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, deployment, and monitoring.
Built an LLM-powered clinical decision-support agent that retrieves patient history to generate medication recommendations and AI-assisted diagnostic guidance.
Designed retrieval, prompt, and output-guardrail layers for a medical chatbot to improve the reliability of generated recommendations in production.
Built an agentic n8n pipeline that ingests job descriptions, generates tailored resume content with LLMs, and syncs outputs to Google Drive, saving **90%+** of manual time.
Built the Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis retrieval/data layer; caching and optimized query patterns improved data-access performance by **30%** for high-frequency inference calls.
Built an AI-driven wellness platform using LangChain and RAG pipelines, normalizing third-party health data and retrieving context for personalized user plans.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design, development, and deployment.
Engineered a GPT-Canvas-style streaming LLM renderer using token streaming and incremental rendering, achieving **98%** rendering accuracy.
Built SmartMedHx, an AI-assisted patient-intake system using Next.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL that applies LLM extraction to automate clinical workflows.
Designed and deployed an AI coaching assistant serving **1,000+ professionals**.
Built Refill Arena from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Designed data-operations tooling and automation systems that kept platform data and services reliable at scale with **99.9% uptime**.
Improved backend performance by **25%** through query optimization and caching; implemented JWT authentication and Stripe subscriptions for production systems.
Delivered features independently from requirements through deployment while collaborating asynchronously with remote stakeholders.
